title: Guyana y la Guayana Francesa: Petróleo, espacio y geopolítica continental
goal: Contrast Guyana's offshore oil boom and Esequibo dispute with French Guiana's European spaceport in Kourou and social asymmetries.
grammar: Geopolítica de Guyana y la Guayana Francesa

sections.title: Unit 9: The Guianas & Belize — Lesson 4
body: Welcome to lesson 4 of Unit 9 in the Latin American Regional Studies track: Belize, Suriname & The Guianas: Multilingual Frontiers.
In this lesson, we study guyana y la guayana francesa: petróleo, espacio y geopolítica continental, evaluating physical geomorphology, maroon resistance, linguistic pluralism, and geopolitics.

items: Contrast Guyana's offshore oil boom and Esequibo dispute with French Guiana's European spaceport in Kourou and social asymmetries.
Master the lexicon and discourse of guyana-petroleo-espacio-kourou.
